objective: test whether a fixed deeper target-blind proposal frontier supplies enough diverse rescue examples for the unchanged strict selector without sacrificing any current hit
hypothesis: the strict top-1 cache froze a final policy identical to domain-local current across every held shard; exposing the first five ranked proposals from each already-frozen family may increase proposal reachability and training support while the unchanged nested safety rule controls harm

single_algorithmic_variable.name: proposal_depth_per_family
single_algorithmic_variable.failure_closes: this exact k=5 route; do not try k=2, k=3, k=10, refill variants, or a threshold adjustment after seeing any v2.9 outcome

frozen_inputs.upstream_xgboost_fits: reuse the 300 already-frozen v2.8 first/repeat fits; train zero new upstream rankers

proposal_contract.raw_allowed_set: positions 10..99 plus the P11 slot-10 incumbent; positions 0..9 remain protected except that incumbent is re-admitted exactly as in v2.8
proposal_contract.stable_order: descending family score, then lower candidate ordinal
proposal_contract.cross_family_deduplication: merge equal candidate ordinals and bitwise-OR the three family support bits

unchanged_selector.induced_feature_semantics: actionable_unique_count_fraction is unique_count/(3*k), which is /3 for the k=1 compatibility path and /15 for k=5; support bits mean membership anywhere in that family's raw top-k; these are deterministic consequences of the one depth change
unchanged_selector.model: two C=0.2 liblinear L2 logistic heads, fit_intercept=true, max_iter=300, random_state=20260830
unchanged_selector.weights: the exact v2.7 session-normalized rescue and regret weights
unchanged_selector.within_turn_tie_break: utility, then greater family-support count, then lower candidate ordinal
unchanged_selector.session_policy: chronological first-passing latch with at most one supplemental action per session
unchanged_selector.current_policy_fallback: complete domain-local current policy; P11/R08 remains the complete deployment fallback

fold_and_label_boundary.family_rule: reuse the frozen product-family outer/inner assignments
fold_and_label_boundary.surface_phase: first construct and exact-repeat all top-5 runtime surfaces without opening the label archive; derive each H_o session order from the frozen v2.8 held/session_ordinal file and T_o as its ordered complement
fold_and_label_boundary.training_phase: for outer o, the sealed NPZ may then be opened and only T_o rows may be copied, retained, supplied to oof_T label attachment, inner selection, or outer selector fitting
fold_and_label_boundary.compressed_npz_disclosure: NumPy may physically decompress a complete compressed member containing H_o rows; those rows must never be copied, retained, supplied to a fit/selection/metric, or serialized before the one-shot H_o outcome attach
fold_and_label_boundary.mapping_phase: map the selected quantile on target-free T_o full-model reference utilities
fold_and_label_boundary.held_phase: apply once to H_o without passing H_o labels, state, outcome metrics, or oracle membership to any builder or selector API

execution.stage_0: outer 0 first/repeat target-free mechanical build only; no label archive may be opened and session order comes only from frozen v2.8 ordinal files
stage_0_gate: the v2.8 result, source snapshot, and every reused file match the frozen physical audit
raw top-5 uses stable score/ordinal ordering over the exact allowed-91 set
the same enumerator at k=1 reproduces every v2.8 top-1 runtime surface field, including all 19 features, bit-exactly
old top-1 available actions are a subset of top-5 actions
deduplicated width is at most 15 with correct support bits and no current/incumbent/duplicate action
all 19-feature values on available rows are finite and unavailable rows are zero
KEEP composition is bit-exact to domain-local current
causal latch can select no more than one turn per session
label archive and outcome-member access counters are zero
execution.stage_1a: only after Stage 0 passes, build all five outer top-5 oof_T/reference_T/held_H surfaces from first and repeat scores without labels and freeze their exact identity
execution.stage_1b: only after all Stage 1a surfaces are frozen, attach T_o labels to oof_T, run the unchanged inner/outer selector twice, freeze exact target-free H_o policies, and retain no H_o outcome value
execution.pre_outcome_short_circuit: if final chosen and activation are identical to domain-local current across all 2,000 sessions, record target-free No-Go and do not consume outcome attach
execution.stage_2: only for a non-identity frozen policy, commit a one-shot outcome protocol/evaluator before any H_o outcome row is first supplied to a metric, then semantically attach H_o outcomes exactly once

required_for_both: all lineage, source-hash, shape, dtype, privacy, and causal-policy checks

report_only_after_policy_freeze_and_only.candidate_recall_C10_C20_C50_C100: reuse the aggregate values pinned by the tracked v2.0 manifest; do not reopen labels merely to recompute them
report_only_after_policy_freeze_and_only.identity_short_circuit: if Stage 2 does not run because final equals current, all target-informed frontier/oracle fields remain unavailable rather than consuming labels for reporting

stop_rules.mechanical_failure: repair only the preregistered mechanic before any outcome
stop_rules.selector_identity: close as target-free No-Go without opening held outcomes
stop_rules.outcome_failure: close k=5 without changing proposal depth, refill, features, model, weights, utility, quantiles, or latch
stop_rules.outcome_pass: authorize only a full-data artifact freeze and target-free parity/resource benchmark; do not open forbidden splits or run the full evaluator

forbidden: Amazon test or new external data
